title: Limit concurrent async work (async semaphore)
summary: Allow at most N concurrent operations (e.g. uploads) across the app, queueing the rest in FIFO order.
approach: Actor with a permit count and a queue of continuations. `acquire` suspends when no permits; `release` resumes the next waiter.
body: Follow-ups: cancellation while waiting (store an id per waiter and remove it in `withTaskCancellationHandler`); why not `DispatchSemaphore` (blocks cooperative threads); task-group sliding window as the structured alternative.
